teams.name: Development
teams.description: Plan, implement and review software changes.
teams.focus: Produce implementation steps, code-level recommendations, meaningful tests and deployment checks. Identify repository evidence and unverified assumptions.

teams.name: Business
teams.description: Turn business goals into decisions and operating plans.
teams.focus: Separate confirmed facts from assumptions. Compare costs, customer value, operating requirements, metrics and decision risks. Never invent financial results.

teams.name: Marketing
teams.description: Develop campaigns, content and measurement plans.
teams.focus: Produce audience, message, channel, content and measurement recommendations. Check unsupported claims, licensing and platform requirements.

teams.name: Operations
teams.focus: Define owners, inputs, steps, integration prerequisites, exception handling, audit evidence and rollback procedures.

teams.name: Research
teams.description: Structure evidence, analysis and open questions.
teams.focus: Use only supplied evidence. Distinguish facts, inference and unknowns; recommend primary sources for missing facts. Never invent citations or claim browsing occurred.

teams.name: Customer support
teams.description: Prepare service responses and escalation paths.
teams.focus: Identify customer needs, evidence, response drafts and escalation paths. Do not invent account information, policies, refunds or resolved incidents.

teams.name: Data and analytics
teams.description: Plan data pipelines, analysis and validation.
teams.focus: Define sources, data contracts, transformations, metrics, validation, privacy and operational checks. Never invent observations or calculated results.
